items.summary: Cable executives have admitted on earnings calls that their reputations with customers are pretty dismal, and they’re working hard to earn back customer good will.

items.title: Enter the 2026 Fierce Network Innovation Awards before the Oct. 2 deadline
items.summary: The final deadline to enter the 2026 Fierce Network Innovation Awards is Oct. 2, giving telecom, broadband, cloud and AI infrastructure innovators one last opportunity to earn industry recognition and showcase their impact before an independent panel of judges.

items.title: Model skew is a hidden pitfall for telco AI, experts from AT&T, Boost and GSMA warn
items.summary: Boost Mobile Data Scientist Priyank Jain, GSMA’s Director of AI Technologies Louis Powell and AT&T's Mark Austin say the industry needs to pay closer attention to data problems that determine whether models keep working in production.

items.title: KT, SK Telecom tap Samsung for AI-RAN projects
items.summary: Samsung Electronics is well on its way to providing KT and SK Telecom with AI-RAN solutions to advance physical AI.

items.title: Huawei Takes NPO From the Lab Into the AI Machine
items.summary: Huawei has built its 7.2T Hi-ONE near-packaged optical engine into the new Atlas 960E SuperPoD. NPO has moved remarkably quickly from an architectural argument to standards work, functioning hardware and now an AI computing system.

items.title: Fiber sensing may have helped prevent fiber cut that caused massive flight delays
items.summary: The problems began when a communications circuit at a flight control center failed. But the backup solution, a fiber optic cable, had been cut.
